meta.title: LongMemEval small — agent memory evaluation
meta.cost_scope: Measured LLM token usage at list prices; excludes infrastructure, hosting, and unobserved server-side spend.

redis_strategies.name: Remis
redis_strategies.note: Remis retrieves semantically relevant chunks from raw conversations. We recorded 83.4% for this configuration, but could not find a retained raw result file that reproduces it.

redis_strategies.name: Remis + Instruct
redis_strategies.note: Complete official small-split aggregate: 86.14% task-averaged, with 425/500 answers judged correct. Remis top_k=5, context_window=1; Instruct search_limit=40.

leaderboard.name: OMEGA*
leaderboard.note: Different setup: GPT-4.1 generation and grading with benchmark-selected prompts; not directly comparable.

leaderboard.name: PwC Chronos*
leaderboard.note: Different setup: query guidance, reranking, and iterative retrieval; not directly comparable.

leaderboard.name: Remis + Instruct
leaderboard.note: Complete 500-question small-split aggregate: 86.14% task-averaged, with 425/500 answers judged correct.

leaderboard.name: Oracle Agent Memory
leaderboard.note: Reproduced, but with a stronger answer model; not directly comparable to gpt-4o runs.

leaderboard.name: Mastra OM
leaderboard.note: Reproduced score matched the published figure.

leaderboard.name: Remis
leaderboard.note: Remis retrieves semantically relevant chunks from raw conversations. We recorded 83.4% for this configuration, but could not find a retained raw result file that reproduces it.

leaderboard.name: Supermemory
leaderboard.note: Published figure; not reproduced in this evaluation.

leaderboard.name: Amazon AgentCore
leaderboard.note: Available raw backing run used the oracle split, not small; all three memory strategies enabled, top_k=25.

leaderboard.name: langmem
leaderboard.note: Ingest extraction token spend was not captured.

leaderboard.name: Zep / Graphiti
leaderboard.note: Published figure; not reproduced in this evaluation.

leaderboard.name: Mem0
leaderboard.note: Published figure; not reproduced in this evaluation.

leaderboard.name: Google Vertex Memory Bank
leaderboard.note: Shipping product measured here. The ≈70% contextual figure comes from its related research paper.

cost_accuracy.name: Remis + Instruct
cost_accuracy.note: Accuracy is the complete 500-question aggregate; cost is the evaluation's published token-spend estimate.

cost_accuracy.name: Remis
cost_accuracy.note: The 83.4% accuracy and $0.1066 cost values come from the evaluation records; we could not find a retained raw result file with matching settings and result.

cost_accuracy.name: Amazon AgentCore
cost_accuracy.note: Available raw backing uses the oracle split; server-side ingest cost is unavailable.

extraction_evaluation.pricing_basis: OpenAI standard API rates verified July 2026; includes extraction, answering, and embedding token costs.

published_vs_measured.name: Google Vertex Memory Bank
published_vs_measured.note: Published context is from the related research paper, not a product-reported score.

published_vs_measured.note: Measured with all three strategies and top_k=25; retained raw backing uses the oracle split.
